card.name: Words leading into drug abuse statements
card.fires_on: Small words and schedule terms just before abuse, addiction or misuse is named, mainly in controlled-substance warnings. Also fires on a space or 'than' before a count of people abusing drugs.

modes.label: Controlled-substance warning
modes.description: Linking word or 'Schedule' right before the risks of addiction, abuse and misuse are stated for an opioid or stimulant.
modes.example: mal system contains fentanyl, an opioid agonist and a Schedule II controlled substance. As an opioid, fentanyl transdermal system exposes users to<< the>> risks of addiction, abuse, and misuse

modes.label: Drug abuse statistics
modes.description: Words just before the number of people abusing illicit drugs in general web text.
modes.example: Illicit drugs are a global problem with more<< than>> 200 million people abusing drugs

card.writes: The promoted tokens (tables, divert, reserve) are an odd mix, so there is no clear output effect beyond a weak diversion or misuse theme.
card.plain: It lights up on small words just before a label says a drug can be abused or misused.
